A Versatile Career in Comedy and Politics

Kevin Bleyer, an Emmy and Peabody Award-winning writer known for his significant contributions to 'The Daily Show with Jon Stewart' and his work as a speechwriter for President Barack Obama, died in a car accident on October 25, 2026. He was 54. The incident occurred in Millrift, Pennsylvania, where Bleyer maintained a home.

Bleyer’s extensive career spanned television satire, scripted drama, and international media advocacy. Beyond his decade-long tenure at 'The Daily Show,' he contributed to all of President Obama’s White House Correspondents’ Dinner addresses. His work also extended to global civics projects, where he helped launch political satire programs in countries including Kyrgyzstan, Nigeria, and Jordan.

His wife, Nella Vera, confirmed the news. Tributes have flowed from colleagues across the entertainment and political spheres. Further details regarding his life and legacy can be found at the official source: https://deadline.com/2026/10/kevin-bleyer-dead-1237206488/
